classification.difficultyReason: Generalises the three exterior angles without numerical givens using straight angles and the triangle angle sum.

content.prompt: Find the value of $\alpha+\beta+\gamma$ in the diagram below.

spec.description: Scalene triangle ABC, with CB extended beyond B, AC extended beyond C and BA extended beyond A. Exterior labels alpha, beta and gamma occur at B, C and A respectively. Source blue strokes become ordinary black house-style geometry. No angle arcs, numerical values or equality marks are added.
spec.mathematics: One exterior angle at each vertex; each forms a straight angle with its adjacent interior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source point names, exterior-angle symbols and side extensions are visible.

inlines.text: Subtract the triangle’s interior angle sum from three straight angles.

answer.worked:
Each labelled exterior angle and its adjacent interior angle add to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+\beta+\gamma&=3\times180^\circ-(\angle ABC+\angle BCA+\angle CAB)\\\alpha+\beta+\gamma&=540^\circ-180^\circ\\\alpha+\beta+\gamma&=360^\circ.\end{align*}$$
The interior angles of a triangle add to $180^\circ$.
